modern.text: You shall not make for yourself an idol in the form of anything in the heavens above, on the earth below, or in the waters beneath.

familiar.text: Thou shalt not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them: for I the LORD thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me;

modern.text: You shall not bow down to them or worship them; for I, the LORD your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on their children to the third and fourth generations of those who hate Me,

modern.text: You shall not take the name of the LORD your God in vain, for the LORD will not leave anyone unpunished who takes His name in vain.

modern.text: For in six days the LORD made the heavens and the earth and the sea and all that is in them, but on the seventh day He rested. Therefore the LORD blessed the Sabbath day and set it apart as holy.

translation_notes: The Ten Words begin with liberation: YHWH brought you out from the house of slaves before any command is given.
Sabbath protects servants, animals, and sojourners; rest is social liberation practice.
Do not carry the name for emptiness includes misuse of Divine name for false, vain, manipulative, or unjust purposes.
Coveting list reflects ancient household/property ordering and requires later ethical audit; preserve source wording while guarding against treating people as property in application.
Simple earth/uncut-stone altar resists monumental control and technical domination of worship.
safety_note: Exodus 20 should not be framed as abstract legalism or coercive religion. It is liberation-shaped covenant speech that protects worship, rest, family continuity, life, fidelity, property, testimony, and desire from domination.
